interpretation: This is PR lifecycle metadata, not a full code review or complete commit history.
A branch exists independently of its PR; closed-unmerged PRs may still have a live branch.
A PR head SHA may be an older snapshot of a branch after later updates; always inspect exact commit and current branch.
Open draft PR means not merged into default branch; no CI or deployment claim follows from state.
Branch count and PR state can change immediately after snapshot; fetch live GitHub before action.
GTRCM is private. Do not copy its source, PR bodies, secrets, or transcripts into public Baton.
Never infer authorization to operate Greg or wake another ChatGPT conversation from this index.
